name: bricks/find-post
label: Find post
description: Search posts, pages, and templates by slug, title, or free-text fragment. Returns only the records the current user can edit, annotated with Bricks metadata (`bricksEnabled`, `hasBricksData`, `locked`, `builderUrl`).

query.description: Slug/title fragment for text search. Omit to list most recently modified posts. Mutually exclusive with postId/slug/path.

postId.description: Direct lookup by post ID. Returns a single-result list. Mutually exclusive with query/slug/path.

slug.description: Direct lookup by exact post_name. Returns posts matching the slug across allowed post types. Mutually exclusive with query/postId/path.

path.description: Direct lookup by hierarchical path (e.g. "parent/child"). Mutually exclusive with query/postId/slug.

postType.description: Filter to a single post type. Omit to search all editable types.

status.description: draft | publish | pending | private | future | any. Default: any.

bricksOnly.description: Restrict to Bricks-enabled post types + template CPT. Default: false (so non-Bricks posts are surfaced with bricksEnabled: false).

results.description: Matched posts with edit/builder URLs and Bricks metadata.
